headline: Growth accelerates as cost discipline widens margins
summary_short: Lyft's revenue rose 14% y/y to $1,650.5 million as Active Riders grew 17% and Rides grew 8%, while cost discipline lifted Adjusted EBITDA 25% to $132.8 million and narrowed the GAAP operating loss to $5.3 million.
summary_long: Revenue grew 14% y/y to $1,650.5 million on 17% Active Rider growth, 8% Rides growth, and continued international expansion (Freenow, TBR integrations) and marketplace-health improvements; Gross Bookings rose 19% to $4,946.0 million. Cost discipline widened margins: Adjusted EBITDA rose 25% to $132.8 million (2.7% of Gross Bookings) despite sales & marketing up 50% on rider-engagement incentives and G&A up 26% on legal/tax accruals. GAAP net income was $14.3 million versus $2.6 million a year ago. Free cash flow was $287.3 million; Lyft repurchased $300.0 million of stock and had $950.0 million left under its buyback authorization. No forward guidance was disclosed.
